Owen hopes to visit Xi'an one day. The art classroom is one of the best places in the city. Tom is interested in reading. For example, earth is the third planet from the sun.
Owen wrote about the day in the diary. Life is full of small surprises. Owen plays football with Tom every Tuesday. His stamp collection fills three books.
The weather was rainy that day. Both of them like chicken and tea. Owen likes rainy days best. His calligraphy fills the shop signs.
Owen learned a lot about art. Tom's birthday is in April. They took many photos at the model workbench.
